escalations.title: Prototype Pollution RCE in Tinypool
escalations.exploit_scenario: Remote attacker crafts worker-pool options with prototype pollution gadget → arbitrary code execution on CI/test servers
escalations.fix: npm audit fix --force in Source/Frontend (upgrades vitest >=5.0.5)

escalations.title: IP Spoofing via IPv4-mapped IPv6 in proxy-addr
escalations.exploit_scenario: Attacker sends requests with IPv4-mapped IPv6 source addresses (::ffff:1.2.3.4) that proxy-addr fails to match against IPv4 trust lists → IP-based access controls silently bypassed
escalations.fix: npm audit fix in Source/Backend (upgrades proxy-addr >=2.0.8)

escalations.title: Handlebars.js JavaScript Injection (10 CVEs)
escalations.exploit_scenario: Attacker-controlled template input exploits AST type confusion or template bypass in Handlebars → malicious JavaScript injected into compiled templates during build or render phase
escalations.fix: npm audit fix in Source/Backend and affected projects

backlog.title: GET /api/search route is unregistered — runtime breakage
backlog.description: No search.ts route exists and no router import in app.ts. All search.test.ts tests will fail. DependencyPicker typeahead broken at runtime.
backlog.recommendation: Create Source/Backend/src/routes/search.ts implementing GET /api/search?q= and register in app.ts with // Verifies: FR-dependency-search

backlog.title: Traceability enforcer covers only 13 of ~107 FRs
backlog.description: Enforcer scans only the most-recently-modified Plans/*/requirements.md. Specifications/dev-workflow-platform.md (FR-001…069) and Specifications/tiered-merge-pipeline.md (FR-TMP-001…010) are invisible to it.
backlog.recommendation: Extend enforcer to accept --specs flag or config-driven list; add all Specifications/*.md to scan set

backlog.title: FR-dependency-seed — idempotent seed data not implemented
backlog.description: Seed data required by FR-dependency-seed (BUG-0010 blocked_by multiple items, FR-0004 blocked_by FR-0003, etc.) never created. DependencySection has no demo data.
backlog.recommendation: Create Source/Backend/src/database/seed.ts with idempotent startup seeding. Add // Verifies: FR-dependency-seed

backlog.title: FR-TMP-001…010 — zero Source/ traceability for tiered merge pipeline
backlog.description: All 10 FR-TMP-* requirements have zero Source/ traceability. Source/E2E/tests/ does not exist. Partial implementation in platform/ which is solo-session domain.
backlog.recommendation: Determine ownership: if platform/ owns FR-TMP-*, update config to exclude from Source/ coverage. If Source/ needs types/contracts, add with traceability.

backlog.title: WorkItemStatus enum missing pending_dependencies value
backlog.description: FR-dependency-types requires pending_dependencies in WorkItemStatus enum and VALID_STATUS_TRANSITIONS. Dispatch-gating logic cannot express the blocked state in the type system.
backlog.recommendation: Add PendingDependencies = 'pending-dependencies' to WorkItemStatus. Update VALID_STATUS_TRANSITIONS. Add // Verifies: FR-dependency-types. Coordinate across backend-coder and frontend-coder.
